# interfere_surface_destination (Resource)

Manage a surface's destination mapping through an existing integration. Import with workspace-slug/surface-slug. Destroy unlinks the mapping without deleting the surface or integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "interfere_surface_destination" "web" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  surface_slug   = "web"
  integration_id = "installation-id"
  project_id     = "prj_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Identifier of the existing integration installation.
- `project_id` (String) Destination project identifier exposed by the integration.
- `surface_slug` (String) Surface URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique surface identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import interfere_surface_destination.web example/web
```
